subject: Leveling recommendation: candidate for ML Manager -> possible Staff scientist path
messages:
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-12T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Leveling guidance requested — Senior ML candidate (Manager IC tradeoff)

Hi all,

Passing along candidate packet for Kate Greenleaf (resume attached). Hiring manager (external) is asking whether to position as L5 Manager or hire as an L6 Staff-equivalent individual contributor with a management track. Quick summary: 8 years ML infra + product experience, led a small team (3 ICs) at last org, strong cross-functional influence, expected to own roadmap for embeddings/infra.

Questions for leveling:
- Amazon-style span/responsibility vs IC deep specialization — do we anchor to L5 manager or L6 staff?
- Compensation anchor recommendation (base / sign-on / equity) for each option.
- Any headcount/signoff implications if we convert an IC req to a manager req (or vice versa).

Attachments: resume_kgreenleaf.pdf, comp_analysis_greenleaf.xlsx

Thanks —Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Leveling guidance requested — Senior ML candidate (Manager IC tradeoff)

On 2026-05-12 09:18, marcus_lin@redwood.ai wrote:
> Passing along candidate packet for Kate Greenleaf (resume attached)...

Quick thoughts:
- Role expectations matter more than title. If manager duties are 50%+ (direct reports + people ops), L5 Manager makes sense. If candidate will spend majority of time owning models/architecture and mentoring ad hoc, L6 Staff is defensible.
- Compensation anchors (approx):
  * L5 Manager: base $175k–$195k, sign-on $15k–$25k, equity 0.08%–0.12% depending on level of impact
  * L6 Staff: base $195k–$215k, sign-on $20k–$35k, equity 0.12%–0.18%
- Headcount: converting an IC req to a manager req requires manager headcount approval and will affect org span assumptions; we need TL approval from Org Design if changing scope.

If hiring manager prefers manager title to attract people-leaders, we can offer L5 Manager with a 12-month technical career path milestone tied to a promotion review to Staff if metrics hit. That keeps comp lower initially but provides growth.

I can sign off on either anchor once Laura confirms banding / total comp target.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Talent & People Ops | Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-13T08:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Leveling guidance requested — Senior ML candidate (Manager IC tradeoff)

Thanks Marcus — reviewed resume and comp sheet. Longform rationale for leveling:

1) Org impact and scope: Candidate will own embeddings infra roadmap + coordinate with product and infra — broad scope suggests Staff-level expectations. However, current team size (3 ICs) and immediate hiring goals point toward a people-manager need.
2) Long-term signal: Hiring as Manager sends a hiring manager signal to the rest of org and affects future hiring bar; Staff signals deep technical leadership.
3) Recommended compromise: Offer as L5 Manager with explicit 12-month deliverables that, if achieved, trigger a scoped promotion to L6 Staff (time-to-promotion not guaranteed but reviewed). This aligns with the suggestion Rishi made and reduces up-front comp risk while keeping top-of-funnel attractive.

Banding/comp recommendation (finalized after Tessa confirms comp levers):
- L5 Manager anchor: Total cash (base+sign-on) $190k–210k, equity 0.08%–0.12%
- L6 Staff anchor: Total cash $220k–240k, equity 0.14%–0.20%

Operational note: If we convert the req type after extending an offer, we need approval from Finance for budget recoding. Please flag headcount_req_id 3421 on any change.

Laura Bennett
VP, People Operations | Redwood Inference

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai

Date: 2026-05-14T10:10:00-07:00

FYI from comp: recommended final offer (L5 Manager path, per Laura/Rishi compromise) — line items below (all ranges in USD):
- Base: $185,000
- Sign-on: $25,000 (one-time, paid over first paycheck)
- Equity: 0.10% RSU grant with 4-year vesting (1y cliff)
- Target bonus: 10%

We can make base up to $195k if counter needed, but authorize sign-on up to $40k for exceptional cases (approval required from me + finance). If we include strong promotion checkpoint language (12 months, tied to technical milestones and leadership metrics) we should be able to keep initial equity at 0.10%.

Attachments: comp_analysis_greenleaf.xlsx

Tessa Morgan
Comp & Rewards Manager | Redwood Inference
